description: This file defines the MultipartStream class which implements the StreamInterface. It handles creation and management of multipart/form-data streams for HTTP POST/file uploads, including boundary management, stream building, and headers setup.

classes.name: MultipartStream
classes.description: A final class for creating and managing multipart/form-data streams for HTTP requests, supporting boundary generation, element addition, and header management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new MultipartStream with optional elements array and boundary string.

methods.name: getBoundary
methods.description: Returns the boundary string used in the multipart stream.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates whether the stream is writable; always returns false for this implementation.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Generates headers for a part given its headers array.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates the aggregate stream from provided elements, appending boundary delimiters.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds a single element to the stream, setting necessary headers.

methods.name: createElement
methods.description: Creates the stream and headers for an individual multipart element.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves a specific header value case-insensitively from the headers array.
